scope: Typed read-only Python and TypeScript SDK accessors for stored finance collections.

contract.location_filter: The explicit location_id filter overrides a conflicting caller-supplied filter while preserving other list options.
contract.writes_or_calculation: The accessors expose no create, update, delete, calculation, or reconciliation operation.

verification.ruff: passed for changed Python SDK and tests
verification.schema_guard: passed: 74 models, 1555 columns, 1456 scalar types, 10 PostGIS types, 86 JSONB shapes, 23 enum fields, and 50 CHECK-literal fields per SDK

boundary: The accessors read stored facts and snapshots. They do not initiate payments, compute summaries, reconcile balances, independently authorize users, or change CAP-031/MAN-CAP acceptance.
external_access: All checks were offline and used mocked client calls. No database, provider, API, credentials, candidate, legacy service, or seed data was used.
